entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Phew... That was a better fight than[n]I would have expected.
entries.uk: Фух... Бій був кращий,[n]ніж я очікувала.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: This is a result truly deserving of praise.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Yeah, I never thought a simple human[n]would get this far. Nice job!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Now then, allow me to disclose the results[n]of our examination.
entries.uk: Що ж, дозволь оголосити результати[n]нашого іспиту.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: If I had to describe your current state...

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: I would say you are: A Seasoned Warrior.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: In recognition of your efforts, I grant you this.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Looks like we can fight on even terms[n]with you.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Come back any time. We'll be waiting!
